problem_text:
A logistics company must coordinate 10 delivery trucks to transport 10 different shipments across a network of 10 distribution hubs.

Each shipment consists of a fixed route represented as (Hub, Handling time) pairs, where each pair specifies the hub where the shipment must be processed and the time required for handling. The sequence of pairs indicates the mandatory order in which the hubs must be visited.

Shipment details:
* S1 follows the route: (H8, 4) → (H3, 9) → (H2, 5) → (H6, 7) → (H1, 5) → (H10, 8) → (H9, 8) → (H7, 10) → (H4, 10) → (H5, 7)
* S2 follows the route: (H4, 9) → (H10, 7) → (H1, 7) → (H6, 9) → (H2, 6) → (H3, 4) → (H7, 3) → (H9, 5) → (H8, 2) → (H5, 3)
* S3 follows the route: (H1, 3) → (H6, 7) → (H10, 10) → (H2, 5) → (H9, 1) → (H8, 8) → (H5, 2) → (H4, 4) → (H3, 10) → (H7, 10)
* S4 follows the route: (H9, 5) → (H10, 10) → (H1, 10) → (H7, 3) → (H2, 9) → (H6, 10) → (H8, 7) → (H3, 6) → (H5, 2) → (H4, 3)
* S5 follows the route: (H2, 5) → (H9, 5) → (H3, 8) → (H4, 8) → (H10, 4) → (H1, 5) → (H5, 10) → (H6, 9) → (H7, 7) → (H8, 8)
* S6 follows the route: (H5, 2) → (H8, 6) → (H4, 10) → (H10, 4) → (H7, 1) → (H9, 9) → (H1, 2) → (H2, 1) → (H3, 7) → (H6, 6)
* S7 follows the route: (H4, 7) → (H10, 10) → (H6, 5) → (H9, 7) → (H1, 10) → (H8, 3) → (H7, 3) → (H2, 1) → (H3, 2) → (H5, 3)
* S8 follows the route: (H1, 9) → (H6, 7) → (H9, 8) → (H5, 10) → (H4, 10) → (H8, 7) → (H2, 10) → (H7, 5) → (H10, 10) → (H3, 10)
* S9 follows the route: (H2, 5) → (H3, 7) → (H5, 5) → (H10, 7) → (H6, 10) → (H8, 1) → (H4, 8) → (H7, 4) → (H1, 9) → (H9, 5)
* S10 follows the route: (H4, 6) → (H1, 1) → (H5, 1) → (H9, 2) → (H10, 10) → (H3, 9) → (H6, 7) → (H2, 2) → (H8, 7) → (H7, 6)

Each handling operation must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted, and each hub can only handle one shipment at a time. The objective is to determine the processing order of all shipments at the hubs so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
